'''Kruskan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located on the far fringes of the [[Colundra sector/Legends|Colundra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Some of the world's population was made up of [[near-Human]]s, but the planet was forgotten by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Regera Girawn" />

Around [[3000 BBY]], [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] hid a [[Sith holocron (Kruskan)|holocron]] in a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] stronghold on the planet. The planetary [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] later grew up near to the ruins, and the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] was uncovered by the servants of the noblewoman [[Regera Girawn]]. She was affected by its powers, her face and hands burnt by it as it was destroyed. Her [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-potential uncovered, she became mad from the persistent visions she received, terrifying her subjects.<ref name="Regera Girawn" />

Years after the mad Girawn was deposed and fled her domain, the planet made contact with the Galactic Republic again. Having foreseen the event, Girawn forced her way onto the Republic exploration ship, enslaved the crew and went on a galactic expedition to find more [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].<ref name="Regera Girawn" />
